name: Liberality
overview: The Scriptures reveal liberality as a God-honoring response characterized by the willing and timely giving of one's possessions to the Lord and others. From Abraham's acceptance of goods from the king of Sodom (Genesis 14:21) to Jacob's vow to give a tenth of all he receives (Genesis 28:22), the biblical narrative emphasizes generous and purposeful offerings. The Israelites were instructed to set apart the firstborn of their sons and livestock as belonging to the Lord (Exodus 13:2, 13:12), and to promptly offer the first fruits of their harvest (Exodus 22:29), underscoring a heart of gratitude and consecration. These examples collectively show that liberality is rooted in recognizing God's ownership and responding with faithful stewardship.
